operators.name: triu_2d_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as reference step input [N, C, H, W]

semantics: Computes torch.triu(x, diagonal=0) over the last two dimensions of x.
For each batch and channel, result[i, j] = x[i, j] if j >= i + diagonal else 0.
Preserves input dtype, device, shape and contiguous strides; does not alter memory layout.
Implements stable grid-stride traversal with boundary checks for the 2D triangular mask.

operators.name: batch_norm2d_eval_forward
semantics: Applies BatchNorm2d in evaluation mode using running statistics, without updating running_mean/running_var.
For each channel c: y[n,c,h,w] = (x[n,c,h,w] - running_mean[c]) / sqrt(running_var[c] + eps) * weight[c] + bias[c].
If weight is None, omit scaling; if bias is None, omit offset.
N, C, H, W are derived from the input shape; reduction is over N,H,W for each channel.
Input is processed with grid-stride loops, preserving the original strides; no transposition or layout changes.
Applies torch.triu with diagonal=0 over the last two dimensions of x (H=512, W=56).
Input and output shapes: [64, 64, 512, 56], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
Only elements with col >= row are retained; the rest become zero.
Applies BatchNorm2d evaluation over x using its running_mean and running_var.
Affine parameters (weight and bias) are present; eps=1e-05.
Input and output shapes: [64, 64, 512, 56], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
